name: Animated Rotating Words for Elementor
author: Labib Ahmed

sections.description:
Animated Rotating Words for Elementor adds a lightweight custom widget for Elementor that lets you create animated rotating text inside any sentence or heading.

Features:
* Before and after sentence text controls.
* Repeater field to add unlimited words.
* Global font size option for before/after text.
* Animation presets (Fade, Slide, Zoom, Bounce, Rotate).
* Interval and animation duration controls.
* Pause on hover option.
* Full Elementor-style controls for styling and design customization.

Perfect for headlines, call-to-actions, hero sections, and attention-grabbing content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/animated-rotating-words-for-elementor/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor editor.
  4. Search for Rotating Words widget in the Elementor panel.
  5. Drag and drop it into your page and customize it as needed.
sections.faq:
Does it work with any theme?

Yes, as long as your theme is compatible with Elementor.

Can I add multiple rotating word widgets on one page?

Yes, you can add unlimited instances.

Can I style the rotating words separately?

Yes, you can use Elementor’s style tab and set animation presets for individual widgets.
